blockers.title: Signed-in clients can overwrite the global verse-insight corpus
Chapter-depth failures are falsely presented as unwritten content

findings.title: Global verse-insight writes are open to non-anonymous clients
Failures collapse into a false unwritten state
Full depth on every verse destroys passage continuity
Deeper and Deeper insight describe different actions
Star and word-study targets are tiny or visually unmarked
Read mode lacks operable per-verse semantics
Action bar is oversized and increasingly crowded
Kept-offline status is not a verified availability guarantee
Navigation is swipe-only and stops at book boundaries
Transient states and duplicate reader entries lack a coherent Back hierarchy
Top controls consume excessive phone reading space
Long-form study is functional but insufficiently authored and responsive
Small alpha-reduced text and 40dp controls fail launch-quality accessibility
Readable width exists but Study remains a phone column
Chapter packs can generate hundreds of document reads
Hard-coded counts and unfinished-language contradict the completed corpus
